title: List notes as JSON
body:
### summary

As a person who scripts around my notes, I want `notes list` to print JSON when I ask, so that a script can read the list without parsing text.

### completion_goal

1. [api-trace] state: two notes, the second marked done, then `notes -json list`; expected: exit 0 and stdout `[{"n":1,"text":"buy milk","done":false},{"n":2,"text":"call Ada","done":true}]`
2. [api-trace] state: no notes, then `notes -json list`; expected: exit 0 and stdout `[]`

### measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### threshold

2 of 2

### scenario

Add two notes, mark the second done, list them as JSON; list an empty file as JSON.

### environment

the CLI built from the checkout, in a fresh directory
